events.label: Наука
entries: 1928 – Alexander Fleming notices a bacteria-killing mold growing in his laboratory, discovering what later became known as penicillin.

events.label: Образование
entries: 1892 – The first night game for American football takes place in a contest between Wyoming Seminary and Mansfield State Normal.

2023 – The 2023 Rotterdam shootings occurred, during which two people were killed in a shooting and arson incident at a residence in Delfshaven, Rotterdam. Additionally, one person lost their life in a classroom at the Erasmus University Medical Center.
